_measurement_method: Pillow 11.x + NumPy. Per-row / per-column activity analysis on raster.
_origin_note: Image is a GPT-generated render approved by the user as visual contract. Measured as raster geometry, not as CSS.

background_color._method: Sample of pixels (10..14, 10..14) — top-left calm area.

detected_column_gaps._method: Per-column count of strong content pixels (luminance>50 OR saturation>30). Quiet runs (count<15) of length >=8 are candidates for between-column gaps OR within-column empty bands.
detected_column_gaps._caveat: Detection cannot distinguish between 'gap between columns' and 'large empty area inside an empty column'. Manual review required to map runs to actual column boundaries.

candidate_gaps.role_guess: possibly between col-1 and col-2 OR inside an empty column

kanban_columns._method: NOT directly segmented. The reference is rendered with 4 columns ('A Fazer', 'Em andamento', 'Revisão/Ajuste', 'Entregue') per the visible header text in the image.
kanban_columns.exact_column_x_boundaries: não medido (column-gap detection ambiguous; would need manual annotation or header-circle detection)
kanban_columns.active_column_visual_treatment: presente — coluna ativa exibe borda em gradiente colorido (visível na referência); exata cor/largura da borda não medida

card_within_kanban._method: Reference shows ONE card in 'Em andamento'. Not extracted as a separate bbox here — use reference-task-card.png for card-level metrics.
card_within_kanban.note: The standalone reference-task-card.png (280×532) is the source of truth for card metrics. This kanban-full image contributes overall app width and column-layout context only.

not_measured: exact x boundaries of each of the 4 columns
header bar geometry above the kanban
sidebar geometry (image may be a kanban-only crop — not visible if so)
exact 'kcol-live' border gradient colors and width
measurement_limitations: GPT-generated image may not be pixel-faithful to real CSS rendering — measurements describe the reference render, not the DOM.
Column-gap detection is ambiguous: empty columns produce large quiet bands that look identical to inter-column gaps.
Full Kanban metrics at sub-column granularity require manual annotation, not automated raster scanning.
